name: Stripe
one_liner: Developer API and dashboard for accepting payments, billing, and managing Stripe accounts.
auth_notes: API keys sent as HTTP Basic Auth username (or Bearer header). Restricted keys recommended for live mode. OAuth is documented for MCP clients acting on a user's account; flows not stated on the pages read.
access_notes: Keys are managed in the Stripe Dashboard. Sandbox keys (sk_test_) work without touching live data. Cost and live-mode activation requirements are not stated on the pages read.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve sandbox and live keys, documented REST API with Basic/Bearer auth. Stripe MCP is public preview and will stop accepting full-access secret keys on 2027-01-11, so use an agent key or OAuth there.

identity.quote: Guides the user through Stripe products to help users accept payments, sell products online, set up billing, or build any Stripe integration

auth.quote: The Stripe API authenticates requests using HTTP Basic Auth. Provide your API key as the basic auth username value.

access.quote: You can view and manage your API keys in the Stripe Dashboard.

sandbox.quote: You can use the Stripe API in sandboxes without affecting your live data or interacting with banking networks.

api_surface.quote: The Stripe API is organized around REST.
Too many requests hit the API too quickly.

mcp.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.

buildability.quote: Starting January 11, 2027, Stripe MCP will no longer accept full-access secret keys or non-agent restricted API keys.
